sloka: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तस्यातिचक्रमुः ।धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य सत्पथे निष्ठितस्य च ।। ७.१०.५ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ varṣasahasrāṇi daśa tasyāticakramuḥ ।dharme prayatamānasya satpathe niṣṭhitasya ca ।। 7.10.5 ॥

translations.english: Thus, ten thousand years passed for him, who was striving in righteousness and firmly established on the path of truth.
